hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Identify the first index and the last index where a prime number occurs in the array.

hints.title: Prime Set Identification
hints.text: Precompute prime numbers up to 100 or use a primality test function.

hints.title: Distance Calculation
hints.text: Scan from left to find the first prime index, and scan from right to find the last prime index. Return their difference.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass with constant-time prime checks for numbers up to 100.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space for small prime set.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Find extreme indices of primes in linear time.
